TITLE: Conn Smythe personal files
PHDESC: 84 centimetres of textual records; 488 photographs : black and white and colour; 13 photographs : black and white negatives; 1 photograph : black and white, mounted on metal button : 15.5 x 15.5 centimetres; 6 centimetres of textual records
SCOPE: Series consists of personal records and photographs created and maintained by Conn Smythe that document his family life, military career and personal activities including philanthropic work, recreational pursuits and attendance at social functions. TITLE: Conn Smythe personal photographs
PHDESC: 488 photographs : black and white and colour; 13 photographs : black and white negatives; 1 photograph : black and white, mounted on metal button : 15.5 x 15.5 centimetres; 6 centimetres of textual records (6 pp.)
SCOPE: Sub-series consists of personal photographs, proofs, negatives and some correspondence documenting Conn Smythe's family life and personal activities.  Sub-series contains portraits of Conn Smythe, of his ancestors and relatives, photographs of Conn Smythe's childhood, his wife Irene (Sands) Smythe, and children Stafford, Miriam, Hugh and Patricia Smythe and their extended families.  Sub-series also contains photographs of Conn Smythe's military service during World War I and II documenting his time spent in Prisoner of War camps during World War I, and the formation and activities of the 30th Light Anti-Aircraft Artillery (Sportsmen) Battery during World War II.  The latter contains photographs showing athletes (including some Maple Leaf hockey players) and sports personalities in a military context.  Other photographs included in this sub-series are: official gatherings attended by Conn Smythe; athletic activities and events outside of hockey and horseracing in which Conn Smythe participated (predominantly golf); photographs of Smythe's residence at Caledon Farm; and social events Conn Smythe attended (with Irene) such as the Metropolitan Opera and vacations to Palm Beach, Florida.
